name: avp-music-video
description: Turn an audio file (e.g. a Suno song) into a branded music video with audio-visualizer-python (avp): install avp, discover brand assets in a repo, render from JSON layer templates (waveform, spectrum, bars, logo, title), burn in karaoke lyrics, and encode as small as possible. Headless, with fixes for avp 2.2.4 render bugs.
